q-60574.name: Question 1
q-60574.worked_solution:
We subtract the exponents, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{{x}^{-2}}{{x}^{-5}} & = \\ {x}^{-2-(-5)} & = \\ {x}^{-2+5} & = \\ {x}^{3} & \end{aligned}
$$
